stages.name: classical_core
stages.goal: Establish strong local-search baselines on the larger synthetic benchmark.

stages.name: zero_shot_llm
stages.goal: Measure raw one-shot design quality before any structured repair loop.

stages.name: feedback_ablation
stages.goal: Separate iterative prompting from structured physical feedback.

stages.name: power_gate
stages.goal: Only run power baselines after auditing surrogate-label stability on the pilot synthetic set.

stages.name: future_surrogate_models
stages.goal: Add learned surrogates once synthetic label confidence is high enough.
